translations.web: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
translations.bsb: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
translations.kjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
translations.asv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.
